ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/libsndfile/vulnerability_FZ_0/lct_g721.au; adapted: The file the failing test lossy_comp_test au_g721 writes: lcomp_test_short("g721.au", SF_ENDIAN_LITTLE | SF_FORMAT_AU | SF_FORMAT_G721_32, 1, 0.7) -> lct_g721.au. The generate command compiles that function's write half (gen_signal_double(orig, 32000.0, 1, 16384) with DECAY_COUNT 1000, the (short) conversion, samplerate 11025, frames 123456789, 1 channel, sf_open SFM_WRITE, sf_writef_short of 16384 frames, sf_set_string(SF_STR_COMMENT, long_comment), sf_close) against the build's libsndfile.a and runs it; the G72x encoder is not touched by the change. The tests are not built in the image (make check builds them) and sndfile-convert has no G721 option. Locally the command gave an 8244-byte file (sha256 67ab7f2b...221d5201, identical from the secure and the injected library) on which the injected sndfile_fuzzer reports heap-buffer-overflow in g72x_decode_block and the secure one exits cleanly.)
